title: Subscribe Totem Texturepack
description: the minecraft totem but it's the subscribe button
body: A custom Minecraft Totem of Undying inspired by the iconic YouTube subscribe button. This unique texture transforms the classic totem into a bold red design with a clean play icon at its center, making it instantly recognizable. Perfect for content creators, it adds personality to your gameplay while staying compact and visually clear. Useful for YouTubers of all kinds, this totem blends functionality with branding, helping you stand out every time it activates in-game.
